Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 30 October 2026 30 October 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares and Total Voting Rights Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 11 August 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 26-Oct-2026 276,608 283.4622 279.6000 285.0000 27-Oct-2026 265,881 287.2170 285.4000 288.4000 28-Oct-2026 268,441 287.2955 286.2000 289.0000 29-Oct-2026 270,000 290.8976 288.2000 292.4000 30-Oct-2026 246,691 288.8394 286.8000 291.6000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 957,872,247 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 44,873,767 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 30 October 2026 is 957,872,247 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 11 August 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 16,423,302 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
